statement: You are given a string text. Cut it into pieces so that every piece is a palindrome, a string that reads the same forwards and backwards.
Return the smallest number of cuts needed. A string that is already a palindrome needs 0 cuts.

examples.explanation: One cut gives "aa" | "b", and both pieces are palindromes.
Two cuts give "a" | "bccb" | "c". The string is not a palindrome and cannot be split into two palindromes, so 2 is the minimum.

constraints: text contains only lowercase English letters
